original_question: Assume the positive relation \( inom{d}{\omega} 	o  inom{d}{\omega}^{1,1}_2\) holds. After adding λ many random reals for some λ > d, must that same positive relation for d and ω still hold?
target_in_paper: Section 3, Problem 3.9: assuming \binom{\mathfrak d}{\omega}\rightarrow\binom{\mathfrak d}{\omega}^{1,1}_2, after adding \lambda many random reals for some \lambda>\mathfrak d, does the same positive relation still hold? ([shelah.logic.at](https://shelah.logic.at/files/95093/1012.pdf))

refined_question: Let \mathfrak d denote the dominating number. Assume in a ground model V that the strong polarized relation \binom{\mathfrak d}{\omega}\rightarrow\binom{\mathfrak d}{\omega}^{1,1}_2 holds; equivalently, every coloring c:\mathfrak d\times\omega\to 2 has a monochromatic rectangle A\times B with |A|=\mathfrak d and |B|=\omega. If one forces over V by adding \lambda many random reals for some cardinal \lambda>\mathfrak d^V, must the resulting extension still satisfy \binom{\mathfrak d}{\omega}\rightarrow\binom{\mathfrak d}{\omega}^{1,1}_2? ([shelah.logic.at](https://shelah.logic.at/files/95093/1012.pdf))
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently (by Definition 1.1), is the property that every 2-coloring of \mathfrak d\times\omega admits a monochromatic product A\times B with |A|=\mathfrak d and |B|=\omega preserved after adding \lambda many random reals, for some \lambda>\mathfrak d? ([shelah.logic.at](https://shelah.logic.at/files/95093/1012.pdf))
justification: The nearest official formulation is exactly Problem 3.9 in Section 3. The surrounding paragraph first identifies the relevant invariant as the dominating number and recalls the known consistency result for \mathfrak d=\kappa together with the positive relation, and then poses the random-real question as the parallel of Problem 3.5. Definition 1.1 supplies the exact semantics of the polarized-arrow notation, so the refinement should simply make that notation and the forcing-extension context explicit without broadening the scope. ([shelah.logic.at](https://shelah.logic.at/files/95093/1012.pdf))
